title: Lost in Tokyo
topic: ประสบการณ์ส่วนตัว
lines: Last year, I went to Tokyo with my school for a cultural exchange. On the
third day, I stopped to take a photo of a temple, and when I turned
around, my group was gone. My phone battery was dead, and I could not
read any of the signs. I felt my heart beating fast.
I remembered our teacher's advice: "If you get lost, stay calm and ask
for help." So I walked into a small shop and showed the owner the hotel
card in my wallet. **She** did not speak English, and I did not speak
Japanese, but she smiled, closed her shop and walked with me for
twenty minutes to the hotel. When we arrived, my teacher ran out, looking
pale. **She** had been searching for an hour. I tried to give the shop
owner some money, but **she** shook her head and bowed. I still do not know
her name. Since that day, whenever I see a lost tourist in Bangkok, I
stop to help. It is my way of thanking **her**.
